extracted.name: Coconut and Dulce De Leche Squares
extracted.description: One day I watched the chef Osvaldo Gross make these squares on tv. I knew they were delicious because coconut and dulce de leche is a winning combination. #square #coconut #cuadrados #coconut #dulce #leche #dulcedeleche #Argentina #sweet #pastry #dessert #dulce_de_leche #caramel
ingredient_lines: 135 g unsalted butter, at room temperature
instruction_lines: Sift flour and baking powder. Set aside.
Beat butter, then incorporate confectioners sugar, zest and salt.
Lower speed and add flour and baking powder.
Preheat oven to 350F. Grease a 13-in x 9-in baking pan. Line with a greased parchment paper.
Roll dough into 1/4-in thickness. Place on pan.
Punch holes, cover with parchment paper and place weights on top. Par-bake dough for 5 minutes. Cool.
Mix eggs (without beating them). Add cream and sugar and mix. Set aside.
Spread dulce de leche in an even layer on the par-baked dough.
Combine coconut and egg mixture. Pour over dulce de leche and carefully distribute evenly.
Remove from pan and cut in squares.
